module autovcoder_096725 (
    A,
    B,
    shift,
    AluB_1,
    ins,
    syscall,
    aluX,
    aluY
);
  input [31:0] A;
  input [31:0] B;
  input [31:0] ins;
  input AluB_1, shift, syscall;
  output reg [31:0] aluX;
  output reg [31:0] aluY;
  reg [31:0] X;
  reg [31:0] Y;
  always @(A, B, ins, AluB_1, shift, syscall) begin
    ////////////////////////////////////////
    case (shift)
      0: begin
        aluX = A;
      end
      1: begin
        aluX = B;
      end
      default: begin
        aluX = 0;
      end
    endcase
    ///////////////////////////////////////
    case (syscall)
      0: begin
        if (AluB_1 == 0) begin
          aluY = B;
        end else begin
          aluY = ins;
        end
      end
      1: begin
        aluY = 32'ha;
      end
      default: begin
        aluY = 0;
      end
    endcase
  end
endmodule
